verdict.rationale: The evidence shows workflows that can be created, updated and run through the API or SDK, and job runs that can be triggered on demand. Nothing documents user-defined rules, event triggers, schedules, or automatic actions fired by events such as a new file arriving in a source. Manual or API-initiated runs and the built-in automatic routing of pages to partitioning strategies are adjacent features, not event-driven rule automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
